text: Plugin, repo and marketplace are all named a2a-dispatch.
author: claude-code
rationale: Leading 'a2a' matches directory and GitHub searches for the protocol; claude-a2a and a2a-bridge are taken by several repos; 'driver' reads as a device driver.

evidence.ref: gh search + npm view + plugin-directory-cache on 2026-10-04: no exact match

cost_if_wrong: Renaming after release breaks /plugin install ids and every link.

text: Version 1 is an outbound A2A client only: Claude sends tasks, workers answer.
author: claude-code
rationale: User wants Claude as the driver; a mod cannot listen on a port, so inbound needs a separate server process and an auth story.
choice: Outbound tools plus a polling timer that wakes Claude through $.prompt.submit when a task finishes
alternatives: Sidecar A2A server so other agents can call into the live session

text: A mod's $.http.fetch resolves only after the whole body is read, so A2A SSE streaming (message/stream) is not reachable from a mod.
author: claude-code

evidence.ref: plugin-authoring types claude-code.d.ts HttpResponse/http.fetch doc, Claude Code 2.1.288

text: JSON-RPC calls to workers are written by hand in the mod; @a2a-js/sdk is a dev dependency only, used as the reference server in tests.
author: claude-code
rationale: The mod runtime has no Node and reaches the network only through $.http.fetch; the client surface needed is three methods.

text: JS tooling uses pnpm.
author: claude-code
rationale: Matches the user's other TS repos (Personal site, engrammic app, tessera artifacts).

text: A mod hook has a 10 s budget of its own time; $.clock.sleep counts against it, $.http.fetch and other $ calls do not.
author: claude-code

evidence.ref: claude-code.d.ts HookBudget (ms: 10_000) and clock.sleep doc, Claude Code 2.1.288

revisit: When HookBudget changes in the types

text: send waits inline only within the hook budget (about 7.5 s of polling); slower tasks are tracked and wake Claude when done.
author: claude-code
rationale: A blocking fetch cannot be aborted or timed out from a mod, so a slow worker would hang the tool call; sleeps past 10 s kill the hook.
alternatives: Blocking send (returnImmediately=false) inside the tool call
A wait parameter up to 120 s

text: Plugin, repo and marketplace are all named a2a-mod.
author: claude-code
rationale: User's pick: says plainly it is a Claude Code mod for A2A; still leads with 'a2a' for search. Verified free on GitHub, npm and the plugin directory.
cost_if_wrong: Renaming after release breaks /plugin install ids and every link.

text: Worker tokens come from an environment variable named at /a2a add; the mod never accepts a token value.
author: claude-code
rationale: A slash command's line is kept in the transcript and the model reads it (plugin-authoring reference.md:107).
cost_if_wrong: Changing it later breaks stored workers and the documented /a2a add syntax.

text: Cross-origin trust is pinned to one endpoint origin and checked only when a token is set.
author: claude-code
rationale: A boolean survives a card change and would let a new card move the token to a new origin; without a token a cross-origin endpoint leaks nothing.
choice: trustedOrigin string, re-checked on every /a2a add

text: claude plugin test runs with no Anthropic credential and an empty config dir; claude plugin validate writes no engine types.
author: claude-code

evidence.ref: Opus plan review probe on Claude Code 2.1.288, 2026-10-04

text: A hooks module may import only its own files by relative path and 'claude-code'; node: builtins and npm packages by name are refused by claude plugin validate.
author: claude-code
rationale: Adding a runtime dependency by name breaks module load; a pure-JS library has to be bundled into a plugin file and imported relatively.

evidence.ref: claude plugin validate probe on 2.1.288, 2026-10-04: 'a hooks module imports its own files by relative path and "claude-code", nothing else'

text: The look ships as three presets chosen by a layout setting, default full.
author: claude-code
rationale: User wanted both the pane (B) and the cards+wire (C); presets keep three testable combinations; full is the default because the README GIF shows the default.
choice: userConfig layout picker: full | pane | minimal, plus an animations on/off switch

text: UI effects use cli-spinners frame data and a bundled tinygradient; everything else is hand-rolled in hooks/ui/.
author: claude-code
rationale: Text takes colour props, not ANSI, so ANSI-emitting libraries would need parsing back; Box already draws borders; Ink renders to stdout itself; mods can only import relative files (c12).
choice: cli-spinners (copied frames) + tinygradient (esbuild bundle in hooks/ui/vendor/)

text: tsc reads vendored engine types from types/vendor/claude-code.d.ts
author: claude-code
rationale: validate does not write .claude-plugin/types/ (checked on 2.1.288)
choice: Vendor the types file per pinned Claude Code version
alternatives: Types laid by claude plugin validate

text: Recorded @a2a-js/sdk 1.3.0 wire shapes: v1 SendMessage result is {task}, v1 GetTask/CancelTask result is a bare Task, states are TASK_STATE_* strings, parts are flat {text}; v0.3 results carry kind and states like 'completed'; returnImmediately/blocking:false sends come back 'submitted'; a missing task is error {code:-32001,message}. Without A2A-Version the compat server sends a hybrid card: 0.3 fields (url, preferredTransport, protocolVersion 0.3) plus supportedInterfaces.
author: claude-code
cost_if_wrong: wire.ts parses responses wrong and every call misreports state

text: Does $.http.fetch follow a cross-origin redirect with the Authorization header still set?
author: claude-code

text: The 2.1.288 loader refuses a hooks module that passes $ into a function imported from another file, and one whose $.env.get name is not a string literal (the module does not load at all). Closures built from $ in register.ts may cross an import; a switch over literal names passes.
author: claude-code
rationale: validate errors: '$ is followed only into a function declared in this same file, never across an import' and '$.env.get takes a literal name as its first argument'

evidence.ref: claude plugin validate --strict on hooks/register.ts and a scratch probe plugin, 2026-10-04

cost_if_wrong: the mod does not load in any session

text: registry, command and tracker reach the engine through a Host of closures that register.ts builds from $
author: claude-code
rationale: keeps the plan's file split and the modules testable; the closure form passes validate
cost_if_wrong: a Host member the validator later refuses would need moving into register.ts
choice: hostOf($) in register.ts; other modules take Host

text: Worker tokens come only from the fixed variables A2A_TOKEN_1..A2A_TOKEN_9
author: claude-code
rationale: printenv sidesteps the platform's audit of env reads; a shared token would send one worker's secret to every worker. The fixed set keeps tokens per worker and validate lists every read
cost_if_wrong: users cannot name their own variables; widen if a later Claude Code allows computed names
choice: Read via a switch of literal $.env.get calls in register.ts; /a2a add refuses any other --token-env name
alternatives: One shared A2A_TOKEN for all workers

text: claude plugin validate on the repo root validates only marketplace.json; the hooks module is checked only when plugin.json is the target, so pnpm check validates both
author: claude-code
rationale: the root run passed while register.ts would not load
cost_if_wrong: CI passes a mod that does not load

text: In claude plugin test 2.1.288 the test $ has no state noun and $.state.get/set never reach the test's own on() hooks, so a reload is tested by calling resume() and tick() against a fake Host; session.start under a tracked task is tested in the engine for a single poller
author: claude-code
rationale: the plan offered seeding state through the kit; the engine does not allow it

evidence.ref: test/tracker.test.ts; state.get hook registered by the test was never called

cost_if_wrong: the session.start -> resume wiring line is covered only by validate's call listing and the single-poller test

text: A tool.call hook that passes its next into another function falls through to the engine ('no implementation for tool.call') in claude plugin test 2.1.288; passing next.budget.remainingMs and next.signal as values works
author: claude-code
rationale: validate does not flag it; only the runtime shows it

evidence.ref: test/tools.test.ts runs during the review fix pass

cost_if_wrong: every tool call falls through to the engine

text: Bound each worker call in the send and task tools by the hook's remaining budget
author: claude-code
rationale: fetch waits do not spend the budget, so a silent worker held Claude's turn with no limit; 15 s exceeds the 10 s hook budget
cost_if_wrong: a worker slower than about 9 s to accept a send is reported as not answering
choice: Race the call against $.clock.sleep(remainingMs - 500); a timeout becomes an A2AError sentence, and a slow inline poll still tracks the task
alternatives: A fixed 15 s timeout as in the tracker

text: On Linux, Claude Code 2.1.288 stores a sensitive userConfig value in plain text in $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.credentials.json (mode 0600) under pluginSecrets["<plugin>@<marketplace>"].<field>, not in settings.json; the d.ts says only 'secure storage'. macOS was not tested.
author: claude-code
rationale: SECURITY.md must say where worker tokens rest

evidence.ref: isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: marketplace add + plugin install + plugin configure --values-stdin, then grep, 2026-10-04

cost_if_wrong: users told tokens are in a keychain when they are in a 0600 file

text: claude plugin configure --values-stdin replaces each given option whole (others keep their values), so setting tokens replaces every stored worker token; it needs the full id a2a-mod@<marketplace>, the bare name is refused
author: claude-code
rationale: the /a2a add hint prints this command
cost_if_wrong: a user following the hint wipes other workers' tokens or gets an id error

text: FsStat in 2.1.288 has no mode field (kind, size, mtimeMs, isLink, realPath), so /a2a add cannot warn about a group- or world-readable token file
author: claude-code
rationale: the brief asked for the warning only if stat exposes a mode
cost_if_wrong: a token file readable by others goes unwarned

text: Each worker takes its token from one of three sources set by /a2a add: the sensitive tokens plugin setting (default), --token-cmd, or --token-file; the env-var route is removed
author: claude-code
rationale: the user rejected fixed env-var names; a secret setting needs no shell setup, and command and file sources let people use their own secret stores without the token entering the transcript
cost_if_wrong: a --token-cmd runs a user-supplied command every 5 minutes; sensitive settings rest in a plain 0600 file on Linux
choice: userConfig.tokens JSON map by alias, parsed once from register options; --token-cmd split on whitespace with double quotes and run via $.process.run without a shell; --token-file read via $.fs.read; command and file tokens cached 5 min in module memory, dropped on 401/403 or re-add

text: UI colours use a hand-written two-stop RGB mix; no tinygradient bundle.
author: claude-code
rationale: Only two-stop gradients are used; a bundle adds a vendoring step and a license to carry for ten lines of maths.

text: A worker's question wakes Claude at once and also offers Reply in the pane until someone answers.
author: claude-code
rationale: Keeps Claude the driver without idling, and still gives the user a direct answer path.
choice: Both answer; first wins; row shows answeredBy; user replies reach Claude as prompt context

text: Client modules are refused past ~1,500 coloured cells (100,000 serialised chars) and hook trees past 20,000 nodes; plugin tools get no ToolProgress row.
author: claude-code

evidence.ref: Opus UI review probes on Claude Code 2.1.288, 2026-10-04
